question: How much of the multi-premia blend survives when a human holds at most K coins and trades once a day at a CET check-in?
registration_note: Declared 2026-09-28 before any result of this construction. Legs, parameters, universe and window are exactly multi-premia-v1; nothing is tuned here. K=5 is the user's constraint (<=5 coins); K=3 and K=10 are reported as sensitivity only and never selected.

construction.coin_weight: net per-coin target = sum over legs of (leg blend weight x leg per-coin weight). S1 per-coin weight = vol-sized trend target / number of coins with data; S2/S3 per-coin weights = frozen quantile weights at their last weekly rebalance; leg blend weights = S4 inverse-vol Monday weights.
construction.truncation: each day hold only the K coins with the largest |net target|; rescale them so their gross equals the full-universe gross, capped at 1.0x (no leverage)
construction.execution: decided on data up to 00:00 UTC; traded at the 08:00 UTC 8h open (09:00/10:00 CET check-in); held 24h to the next 08:00 UTC open
construction.reference: V_ALL = the same aggregation and timing with no truncation

economics.funding: same Binance proxy as multi-premia-v1, charged on held weights

pass_rule: H5 passes if Newey-West t >= 2, Sharpe >= 0.5 x V_ALL Sharpe, and Sharpe > 0 in both halves
